scope: Show and switch the active imported multi-configuration directly above the Lens Data table, using the supplied Zemax screenshot as the interaction reference. Preserve unrelated worktree changes.
implementation: The real workspace lens editor has a current/total configuration label, previous/next buttons, and a Multi-Configuration button opening the existing editor without duplicating the document.

Use the existing IMultiConfigurationService.Activate workflow and shared workspace revision events for prescription, system options and views. Add locked, read-only count/index metadata so repainting the toolbar never requests all configurations' optical metrics.

Commit valid DataGrid and numeric LostFocus edits in the old configuration before queued activation; preserve invalid input and explain why switching was blocked. Reject stale queued commands after file changes or disposal; clear old navigation errors on a file switch.

Keep selected surface numbers through configuration switching, undo and redo. Show single-configuration and first/last disabled reasons through the shared ControlAvailability helper, including disabled tooltips and accessibility help.
Localize the current/total label, buttons, tooltips and explanations through the existing live Chinese/English/Japanese hooks. Wrap the header controls for narrow panes without shrinking typography.

Remove automatic multi-configuration document opening from the file-open, library-open and Zemax-import shell routes; the visible header provides an explicit entry while the existing base-page startup rule remains intact.

Related layering regression exposed pre-existing fixed colors in WorkspaceDockGuidance. Move the identical gray preview colors to shared semantic theme resources and bind the preview dynamically; retain the exact color assertions rather than weakening the architecture gate.
Synchronize the built-in three-language user guide and maintained operation guide. No shared Core optical algorithm, tolerance or reference data changed.

fixture.meaning: Byte-preserved imported example used to check configuration selection, actual displayed values and fresh 2D viewer revisions. This is not a new Zemax numerical certification.

preservedIntermediateEvidence: navigation-initial.log: test compilation required the complete headless Escape-key API arguments; the harness was corrected.
navigation-after-compile.trx: all initial eight navigation cases passed.

configuration-related-debug.trx and configuration-related-release.trx: each 295 passed and one failed. The sole failure was the pre-existing WorkspaceDockGuidance fixed-color architecture violation; final acceptance reruns use semantic resources with unchanged gray values.

configuration-debug-accepted.trx, configuration-release-accepted.trx and navigation-skia-accepted.trx: a newly strengthened viewer assertion tried to find a visual control inside an inactive tab before its template had ever loaded. The fixture now visits the actual 2D tab before retaining its scene control; the revision/refresh assertion was retained. real-viewer-template-check.trx passed before the final full related reruns.

representativeCapture.meaning: Actual workspace rendered offscreen after switching to configuration 2/3; shows aperture 6.2, surface 8 thickness 4.48 and surface 15 thickness 21.21. This image and the Light header screenshot were visually inspected.

countingRule: Scoped regression and isolated rendering collections overlap and must not be added. Screenshots render real controls offscreen, without operating the user desktop.
